source: uploaded odysseus-main.zip and public README feature map

features.name: Chat / provider switching
features.odysseus_surface: Chat with local or API models: vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, OpenRouter, OpenAI.
features.nova_adaptation: Nova keeps its existing provider commands and exposes this suite as the feature coverage audit.

features.name: Agent tools + guarded autonomy
features.odysseus_surface: Agent with MCP, web, files, shell, skills and memory tools.
features.nova_adaptation: Nova already has autonomous/tool routing; this patch adds an Odysseus-style privilege policy table and command checker.

features.name: Hardware-aware model cookbook
features.odysseus_surface: Hardware scan, VRAM-aware fit scoring, model recommendations and serving/download planning.
features.nova_adaptation: Nova now detects RAM/CPU/NVIDIA VRAM where available, accepts what-if hardware hints, ranks local model choices and prints install/serve guidance without auto-downloading.

features.name: Deep research reports
features.odysseus_surface: Multi-step source gathering, reading and synthesis into a report.
features.nova_adaptation: Nova keeps its existing research engine and documents the Odysseus deep-research target in the suite manifest.

features.name: Blind model comparison
features.odysseus_surface: Prompt two models side-by-side, hide model names, record winner/tie and reveal after vote.
features.nova_adaptation: Nova now creates blind comparison packets and stores comparison/vote receipts under the workspace runtime directory.

features.name: Documents-first editing
features.odysseus_surface: Markdown/HTML/CSV editor with AI suggestions while the user owns the text.
features.nova_adaptation: Nova now has a workspace document vault with create/list/read/suggest/export commands and explicit AI-suggestion sidecars.

features.name: Memory and skills
features.odysseus_surface: Persistent memory/skills with vector + keyword retrieval, import/export and audit surfaces.
features.nova_adaptation: Nova now adds skill library CRUD/export and memory-vault audit/export commands on top of its existing memory commands.

features.name: Email triage scaffold
features.odysseus_surface: IMAP/SMTP inbox with urgency reminders, tags, summaries and reply drafts.
features.nova_adaptation: Nova now exposes a no-secret integration checklist and triage schema. It does not connect to mail until credentials and explicit consent are configured.

features.name: Notes and tasks
features.odysseus_surface: Quick notes, checklist tasks, reminder channels and scheduled agent actions.
features.nova_adaptation: Nova now stores notes/tasks as workspace JSON with add/list/search/done/export operations.

features.name: Calendar scaffold
features.odysseus_surface: Local-first calendar, CalDAV sync, .ics import/export and agent-aware events.
features.nova_adaptation: Nova now provides an .ics-oriented integration plan and event schema without silently syncing external calendars.

features.name: Mobile/PWA readiness
features.odysseus_surface: Responsive, installable and touch-friendly mobile UI.
features.nova_adaptation: Nova now has a mobile/PWA readiness checklist command that maps required files and regression checks for the current web UI.

features.name: Extras: uploads, vision, image, themes, sessions, web search, presets, 2FA style hardening
features.odysseus_surface: Image editor, theme editor, uploads, vision/PDF, web search, presets, sessions and two-factor extras.
features.nova_adaptation: Nova already has file/image/chat/web search surfaces; this patch adds presets plus theme/auth hardening plans.

features.name: Backup, vault and webhooks
features.nova_adaptation: Nova now has a privileged-integration gate command that classifies risky actions before implementation or use.
